page.notes: Marginal notes on the right edge are cut off and largely illegible, so they are not transcribed. The text of the notes, the Greek words (acceptor personarum, ἀνθρωπος-type Greek in line 2 and τηλικώτερον-type Greek in line 4) and several line ends are partly illegible; the bracketed "..." marks sections I could not read. Greek words in the scan are only approximated here.
